issue.subject: Salt the beans the night before (yes, really)
issue.preheader: Plus a 20-minute escarole soup, and the one pot I would keep.
issue.title: Salt the beans the night before
body: For years I believed salting dried beans made their skins tough. It doesn’t. A tablespoon of salt in two litres of soaking water gives creamier insides and skins that hold together.
I tested it on four batches of cannellini this fortnight, salted and unsalted, side by side, and asked my neighbours to taste blind. Three batches out of four, they picked the brined beans.
